SEO/META in <head>: <title>ARTIFACT: Museum Night — Premium After-Hours Museum Event</title>, meta description, Open Graph og:title, og:description, og:image (use https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x630?museum,night), og:type=website, viewport meta, charset utf-8.

   - Mobile hamburger button (pure CSS/JS, no external icon library — build hamburger from 3 <span> bars) toggling a slide-down/slide-in mobile menu panel; menu closes on link click and on outside click.

2. HERO (id="hero", full viewport height):
   - Background image https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night as CSS background-image with dark gradient overlay (linear-gradient burgundy/navy/black) + a soft radial "spotlight" gradient layer + the grain overlay.
   - Small eyebrow/kicker line "ARTIFACT: Museum Night"
   - Large serif headline "Museum Night, Reimagined" (clamp() huge size)
   - Subcopy paragraph (1-2 sentences, atmospheric)
   - Event metadata badges row: "18 October 2026", "19:00 – 02:00", "The Old Gallery, Warsaw" each as a small pill/badge with thin gold border
   - CTA row: "Get Tickets" (primary gold button, scrolls to #tickets) and "Save to Calendar" (secondary outlined button, id="saveCalendarBtn", triggers ICS download — no href needed, JS handles it)
   - subtle scroll-down indicator at bottom of hero

3. CONCEPT / INTRO (id="program" is the Program Timeline section — put Concept section right before it, its own id="concept"):
   - Section eyebrow + serif heading, e.g. "An Exhibition After Dark"
   - One editorial paragraph (3-4 sentences) about the event concept
   - 3 feature cards in a row (glass panel style, hover lift): "After-Hours Exhibitions", "Live Performances", "Guided Hidden-Room Tours" — each with a short 1-2 sentence description and a small gold icon (inline SVG, simple line icon, no icon library)

4. PROGRAM TIMELINE (id="program"):
   - Section heading "The Night, Hour by Hour" or similar
   - Vertical timeline with a central/left gold line and alternating or left-aligned entries (use CSS, must look elegant), each entry = time + title + 1-sentence description + a small location tag (e.g. "Main Hall", "Sculpture Court"). Include exactly these 8 entries in order:
     19:00 Doors Open; 19:30 Curator Welcome; 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour; 21:00 Live Ambient Performance; 22:00 Sculpture Hall Projection; 23:00 Artist Talk; 00:00 Midnight Gallery Walk; 01:00 Closing Sound Session.
   - Each timeline item has `.reveal` class for scroll animation.

5. ARTISTS / SPEAKERS (id="artists"):
   - Section heading, e.g. "Voices of the Night"

   - Invent 8 plausible artist/curator names, roles (e.g. "Sound Artist", "Chief Curator", "Sculptor", "Light Designer", "Performance Artist", "Art Historian", "Composer", "Installation Artist"), short teasers, longer bios (2-3 sentences), and session times matching the timeline.
   - Artist modal (id="artistModal", hidden by default, role="dialog" aria-modal="true"): shows enlarged image, name, role, longer bio, session time, and a visible close button (×). Must close on: close button click, ESC key, and backdrop click. Must trap nothing fancy but must be accessible (aria-labelledby, focus the close button on open, restore focus to trigger element on close).

6. VENUE (id="venue"):
   - Venue name "The Old Gallery" and full address (invented realistic Warsaw address)
   - Travel tips paragraph, Accessibility notes paragraph (step-free access, accessible restrooms, assistive listening), Parking/public transport notes paragraph
   - Inline SVG "map mock" (hand-built, not a real map): a rectangle representing the gallery block, a few street lines, a metro/bus marker (simple circle+icon), an entrance marker (pin shape), and a dashed/solid gold route line connecting transit marker to entrance. Label with <text> elements. Keep it schematic/stylised, dark background matching theme, gold linework.

7. TICKET TIERS (id="tickets"):
   - 3 ticket cards in a row, glass panel style, middle one "Curator Pass" has a "Recommended" ribbon/badge and is visually elevated (scale/border glow):
     - Night Pass — €29 — bullets: Entry after 19:00 / Main exhibition access / Program access
     - Curator Pass — €59 — bullets: Everything in Night Pass / Hidden collection tour / Reserved artist talk seating
     - Patron Pass — €129 — bullets: Everything in Curator Pass / VIP lounge access / Signed event print / Priority entrance
   - Each card has a "Select Tier" button with data-tier, data-price attributes opening the ticket checkout modal pre-filled with that tier.
   - Ticket modal (id="ticketModal", accessible dialog): shows selected tier name (editable via a small select/tier switcher inside modal), fields: attendee full name (required), email (required, validated with regex + inline error message), number of tickets (number input min=1 max=8, default 1), auto-computed total price (tier price × quantity, live-updates on change), a required checkbox "I agree to the terms" (must be checked to submit), "Confirm Reservation" submit button. On submit: validate all fields, show inline error messages if invalid (name empty, bad email, terms unchecked), and on success hide modal, reset form, and show a success toast ("Reservation confirmed — check your email" style) — no real payment, clearly mock. Modal closes on ESC/backdrop/close button too.

8. FAQ ACCORDION (id="faq"):
   - At least these 6 Q&A pairs, accessible accordion (button with aria-expanded toggling a panel, only CSS/JS, smooth height transition via max-height or grid-template-rows trick):
     1. "Is payment processed on this page?" → answer clarifying this is a demo, no real payment is taken.
     2. "Can I arrive late?" → answer.
     3. "Are photos allowed?" → answer.
     4. "Is the venue accessible?" → answer referencing step-free access.
     5. "Can I change my ticket tier?" → answer.
     6. "How do I save the event to my calendar?" → answer referencing the Save to Calendar button.

9. NEWSLETTER section:
   - Heading, short line of copy, email input + submit button in a form (prevent default), inline validation (invalid email shows inline error text/red border), on valid submit show a success toast ("You're on the list") and clear the input.

10. FOOTER:
   - "ARTIFACT" logo repeated
   - short credits line (e.g. "Curated by the ARTIFACT collective")
   - a row of social-style text links (Instagram, X, Facebook — plain text/# links, no icons needed or simple inline SVGs)
   - copyright line with current year via JS (document.write-free, use textContent/innerHTML with new Date().getFullYear())
   - small note: "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase."

GLOBAL JS BEHAVIOR (single inline <script> at end of body, wrapped in DOMContentLoaded or placed at end, use 'use strict', no console.log/console.error left in — must produce zero console errors/warnings):
- Save to Calendar: build an ICS string with these exact fields — SUMMARY:ARTIFACT: Museum Night, DTSTART:20261018T190000, DTEND:20261019T020000, LOCATION:The Old Gallery, Warsaw, DESCRIPTION:A cinematic after-hours museum event with exhibitions, performances, talks, and guided tours. — include VCALENDAR/VEVENT wrapper with UID and DTSTAMP, create a Blob of type text/calendar, generate an object URL, create a temporary <a> with download="artifact-museum-night.ics", click it programmatically, then revoke the object URL. Must work with zero backend.
- Sticky navbar scroll class toggle + active-section highlighting via IntersectionObserver.
- Mobile menu open/close toggle.
- Scroll reveal via IntersectionObserver adding `.is-visible` to all `.reveal` elements when they intersect (threshold ~0.15), unobserve after reveal.
- Artist modal open/populate/close logic (event delegation on the artist grid for the View Details buttons).
- Ticket modal open/populate (from Select Tier buttons)/live total calculation/validation/submit success toast/close logic.
- FAQ accordion toggle logic (only one open at a time OR independent toggles, either is fine, just must work smoothly).
- Toast notification helper function: creates/reuses a fixed-position toast element, sets text, shows it with a CSS class for ~3s then hides (use setTimeout), supports being called multiple times.
- Newsletter form validation + toast.
- Footer year injection.
- All event listeners added via addEventListener (no inline onclick attributes) so there are no console errors when opened directly via file:// protocol.

ACCESSIBILITY & RESPONSIVE:
- Use semantic landmarks (header/nav, main, section, footer), aria-labels on icon-only buttons (hamburger, modal close buttons), visible focus outlines (don't remove outline without providing a custom focus-visible style using var(--gold)), sufficient color contrast for body text against dark backgrounds using --ivory/--muted.
- Fully responsive: hero, feature cards, timeline, artist grid, ticket cards, venue layout, footer all reflow gracefully at mobile widths (~375px–430px) via media queries (e.g. max-width: 900px and max-width: 600px) — stack grids into single columns, shrink hero headline via clamp(), collapse navbar into hamburger menu below ~900px.

Output the ENTIRE html document as the file content (from <!DOCTYPE html> to closing </html>), fully self-contained, well-indented, with organized CSS using the custom properties defined above and organized, commented sections in both the <style> and <script> blocks.
"}
